description: Port upstream bedrock.ts + bedrock-shared.ts as new umbrella app octo_pi_ai_bedrock. Amazon Bedrock uses the Converse Stream API. Main complexity is auth: SigV4 signing with credential chain (env vars, profile, static, ECS, IRSA). Scope: request builder (ConverseStream format), decoder (ConverseStream events to canonical events), AWS auth, thinking/reasoning support (budgetTokens), Producer + Provider + Application wiring. Upstream ref: bedrock.ts (~350 lines), bedrock-shared.ts (~400 lines)
title: Amazon Bedrock provider (octo_pi_ai_bedrock)
